episodes.name: The Deadly Dust (1)
episodes.overviewEn: In protest of plutonium being stored at the university, a small group of students steal it and build an atomic bomb to prove that it can be done.  After an entrepreneur learns the location of the bomb and steals it, Spider-Man must track it down and disable it.

episodes.name: The Deadly Dust (2)
episodes.overviewEn: In protest of plutonium being stored at the university, a small group of students steal it and build an atomic bomb to prove that it can be done.  After an entrepreneur learns the location of the bomb and steals it, Spider-Man must track it down and disable it.

episodes.name: The Curse of Rava
episodes.overviewEn: A religious cult from Kalistan protests when a statue of their god, Rava, is on display at the museum.  Spider-Man must face the cult leader, Mandak, who has telekinetic powers.

episodes.name: Night of the Clones
episodes.overviewEn: When a scientist, Dr. Moon, clones himself, his clone tries to kill members of the Tovald Committee, who has denied the real Dr. Moon the Tovald Award 5 straight years.

episodes.name: Escort to Danger
episodes.overviewEn: When the daughter of the President of Tavilia participates in the Miss Galaxy Pageant, she is kidnapped by a rival family in order to force the president to relinquish power to them.

episodes.name: The Captive Tower
episodes.overviewEn: When $10 million is stolen from the safe of a newly constructed, computer controlled building, the thieves program the computer to lock down the building.  Spider-Man must free the occupants and catch the thieves.

episodes.name: A Matter of State
episodes.overviewEn: During the theft of some NATO defense plans at the airport, Julie Masters inadvertently takes a picture of one of the thieves.  When they go after Julie, Spider-Man must protect her while trying to recover the stolen plans.

episodes.name: The Con Caper
episodes.overviewEn: After being released from prison, an ex-politician breaks out his partners and try to steal $100 million.

episodes.name: The Kirkwood Haunting
episodes.overviewEn: A widow is haunted by the spirit of her late husband, who tells her to donate his estate to a private organization which investigates paranormal phenomenon.  Jameson, being a friend of the family and knowing Parker is a graduate student in physics, asks Parker to investigate.

episodes.name: Photo Finish
episodes.overviewEn: Parker suspects he is being used to frame an innocent person when he develops an incriminating photograph he didn't take.  He is then jailed for contempt when he doesn't turn the photo over to the police.

episodes.name: Wolfpack
episodes.overviewEn: When a Sorgenson Chemical representative discovers a mind control drug works, he uses it on the students developing it.

episodes.name: The Chinese Web (1)
episodes.overviewEn: In order to keep his job, Min Lo Chan, China's Minister of Industrial Development, ventures to America in search of three U. S. Marines that can clear his name. Standing in his way is a wealthy American industrialist whose plans for a large steel contract hinge on Chan's failure.
